Source hash and fresh DSP guards passed. The history artifact13078840970 and its archive digest were verified; Actions native frames1290 and1636 exactly match the local native pixels, so this is not an environment drift. Local passes and acceptance of the separate RIFT-V02 single-landscape preference cannot waive this failed required gate. Initial staging plus two substantive repairs for the explicit2026-11-01 request are exhausted; a softer, integrated luminous flame would require another substantive drawing revision, so this request stops without automatic repair, retry or candidate-number reset.
